snippet.title: Abu Batata - Official Demo Trailer | An Egyptian Street Vendor Simulator
snippet.description:
Welcome to Abu Batata!

Play the FREE Demo:
https://ygstudio.itch.io/abu-batata

Run your own sweet potato cart in the streets of Egypt, serve customers, earn money, and experience authentic Egyptian street life.

🥔 Features
• Cook and sell sweet potatoes
• Upgrade your cart
• Funny customer interactions
• Story-driven gameplay
• Authentic Egyptian atmosphere
• Original sounds & music

🎮 Play the Demo:



💬 Join the Discord:
https://discord.gg/S34rxrF2uY
